name: On the Scent
summary: Sphinx — the estate brain, built from Release the Hounds. Summarises every hound's released result (page cache + the Nemesis / Atlas / Sköll snapshots) into one story: how exposed the estate is and what the risk is made of, where it concentrates (by hound, on assets, in time), the cross-hound overlaps no single hound sees, blind spots, ranked next moves and which hounds the picture was built from. Every number links to the hound that owns it. Needs a release; reads caches only, never navi.db.
